wheel_forces — DRIVE roverslip op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × table × any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.wheel_forces(sinkage, slip, wheel, soil, n_quad: 'int' = 96) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import roverslip; roverslip.wheel_forces(sinkage, slip, wheel, soil, n_quad: 'int' = 96) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("wheel_forces"))

Usage

Forces a rigid wheel receives from the soil at sinkage z [m] and slip ratio s (numerical integration of the Wong–Reece stress distribution).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

返り値 {"Fz", "DP", "T", "theta_f", "theta_m", "theta_r"}: 垂直力 [N]、牽引力(drawbar pull、前向き正)[N]、駆動トルク [N·m]、角 [rad]。sinkage・slip はスカラーか同じ形に放送できる配列(0 ≤ z < r、−1 < s < 1)。
